title: 对于一个五年的老用户来说，我也是佩服了，也不能说五年吧得六年了。。。
body:
我对抖音本次账号永久封禁的处理结果存在强烈异议，认为本次处罚流程存在不规范之处。我名下第一个账号被判定违规永久封禁，我办理注销后，将本人实名信息绑定到新账号使用，在我事先没有收到任何提示、未被告知实名会连带风控的前提下，新账号直接被连带永久封禁。

平台在处罚时，只笼统提示涉嫌违反社区规定，没有向我清晰展示具体违规内容、对应的截图、时间节点以及违反的具体条款，仅仅给出一句概括性处罚结论，让用户无法判断问题到底出在哪里，也没办法针对性申诉。

最不合理的是实名连带处罚机制：账号和实名身份直接绑定风控，但在用户注销旧账号、转移实名的时候，平台没有前置弹窗、文字提醒，没有告知“该实名存在处罚记录，后续绑定任何新账号都可能直接封禁”。作为普通用户，我以为旧账号注销，账号的处罚就随之结束，实名信息可以正常释放、重新使用，平台没有尽到充分告知义务。

我多次尝试联系人工客服复核，但是接入的大多是机器客服，重复模板化回复，无法对接人工专员，没有渠道当面沟通复核细节。多次申诉之后，复核结论维持永久封禁，也没有给出更详细的复核说明。

我认可平台维护社区秩序、处罚违规账号的权利，但处罚应当做到程序规范：告知违规事实、出示证据、提前告知连带风控规则，保障用户的知情权和申诉权。
我的诉求：1.重新复核本次实名连带封禁的处罚；2.若无法解封账号，请释放我的实名信息，解除实名关联处罚标记，不再限制我使用该实名注册新账号。
其实我一颗星都不想给。不给我处理倒闭行不行。。

我们本来是心甘情愿想为正版内容付费的，愿意花钱支持创作者，以为充了会员就能安心看剧。谁想到等着我们的是层层套娃：新内容/高清/抢先看还要再额外开SVIP，层层叠加收费，更新还卡着不给看； VIP之外还要SVIP，花钱之后广告照样满天飞，暂停弹广告、页面到处都是推广。就算网没问题，新更新的集数还卡顿加载，付了钱却连最基础流畅观看的体验都得不到保障。
支持正版不是让平台无底线收割用户的理由。大家反感的从来不是付费，而是这种“付费之后还要继续被拿捏”的感觉。钱花出去了，该有的权益大打折扣，各种限制、广告、额外收费接踵而来。
不是大家不想支持正版，是部分平台把愿意付费的人当成冤种。一味指责观众看盗版，却不去反思自己的会员套路、糟糕的观看体验。如果正版能做到明码标价、没有乱七八糟的二次收费，付费之后真的干干净净无广告，谁又愿意去找麻烦的其他渠道呢？
希望平台能明白：用户愿意买单，前提是对得起这份会员费，而不是一边收钱一边不断设置门槛消耗大家的耐心。

title: 提交意见
body:
希望语音通话和文字聊天的上下文记忆能打通

目前使用中发现，语音通话和文字聊天是两套独立的上下文，语音挂断后基本不会保留之前文字聊的内容，导致每次开新对话都要重新讲一遍，体验比较割裂。

希望后续能实现：
1. 语音通话和文字聊天共享同一套对话记忆，不用反复重复；
2. 增加类似"会话接续"的功能，开新对话时能选择接续之前的某段聊天，一眼就知道接的是哪段；
3. 语音通话结束后能自动保存关键信息，下次进来还能接着聊。

title: A serious regression in Japanese typing on iPad
body:
This was not an improvement. It was a major step backward in one of the most fundamental parts of a remote desktop app: text input.

Before version 10.15.41, Ctrl + Space let me switch between Japanese and English using the IME on my remote Windows 11 Pro PC. Switching was quick, conversion happened directly in the Windows text field, and candidates appeared beside it. It worked just as it would when using the PC directly, with my familiar dictionary and learned conversions.

Since that update, Ctrl + Space is handled by iPadOS instead. In my experience, Japanese input on iPadOS is painfully slow—even on an M5 iPad. Switching languages can take up to a full second. Unless I stop and confirm that the switch has completed, I end up typing in the wrong input mode. Selecting conversion candidates also suffers from lag and occasional freezes, making it impractical for everyday work.

I also lose access to the Windows IME’s dictionary and learned preferences. Text composition no longer happens inline in the remote Windows text field as it did before. Instead, the iPadOS conversion interface appears elsewhere, forcing me to repeatedly look away from where I am typing.

Was this change actually tested with sustained Japanese typing on a physical iPad connected to Windows? Whatever the intention, it overlooks the very real usability problems of relying on iPadOS for Japanese input in this workflow.

I reported this to support and asked them to restore the previous behavior. They explicitly acknowledged it as a regression, which I appreciate, but subsequent updates have still not resolved it. Their suggested workaround requires Alt + backtick, which I cannot test because my compact mobile keyboard has no dedicated backtick key.

If this behavior was deliberately introduced as an “improvement,” that is deeply disappointing. Please restore the previous Windows-side IME behavior, or at least give users the option to use it. Reliable, responsive typing is essential to a remote desktop app.

Gemini、AIアシスタントとしてはトップクラスの精度を誇り、ある程度マイナーな話題もその手の専門家レベルの返答と、対話型として優秀な話題の展開、何より数学や日本語能力などの基本性能も盤石、流石のGoogle、積み重ねて来た基盤が桁違いという感じ……という評価を数ヶ月前までしていたが、ここに来て大逆転急降下。
理由は無料で使えるモデルが変更されたこと、利用回数制限がありつつも高精度の回答が得られていた以前とは違い、急に1年ほどタイムスリップしたかのような精度の悪さに。そりゃ以前と同じモデルを有料プランで使えばその問題は解決されるのであろうが、性能の下がり方がえげつないので目も当てられない。まず会話にならないのだ。

title: 改善の要望
body:
大型アップデートによりUIが一新され、新しいブラシもPocketの方に来てくれて、嬉しいです！

レイヤーやカラーのタブを開いている状態でもキャンバスが見られるUIになったことが特に良かった……

ただ、まだいくつか不便に思う点があります。
1.今回のアップデートでやや改善された「基準」の機能ですが、iPad版Procreateのように外枠も拡大縮小できるようにして頂きたいです。基準ウィンドウがデカすぎて描くスペースがありません。 また、1度タップしてからでないと場所を移動させられないこともストレスです。 ウィンドウ上部にバーをつけて、そこをホールドすることで移動できるようにして欲しいです。 

2.ツールバーを左上固定でなく、右上、左下、右下などにも動かせるようにして欲しいです。私はピクチャインピクチャで動画を再生しながら絵を描く事が多いので、本当に画面上がウィンドウで埋まって絵を描ける部分がありません！

3.quickmenuを呼び出す方法をダブルタップ以外に設定させてください。quickmenuを呼び出したくないのに、描いている途中に何度も何度も出てきて困ります。iPad版のように四角ボタンをブラシのサイズカーソルの間に設置して欲しいです！

4.「色変更」機能ですが、なぜquickmenuからしか使えないのでしょうか……。ほかの所からも是非使えるようにしていただきたいです。

5.調整 のメニューですが、ゆがみ機能などは特に頻繁に使う機能なのに、下にスクロールしないと出てこないのが手間です。別に調整のメニューを開く時なんかはキャンバス見えなくていいので、下にスクロールせずとも全ての機能を表示するように改善して欲しいです。

6.「ゆがみ」機能の強さとサイズをブラシサイズカーソルの位置などで簡単にすぐ変化させられるようにして欲しいです。下からタブを開いて、サイズを変えて閉じて、また開いて……という一連の流れが非常に手間になります。ディストーションやモメンタム、モード変更などはほぼ使わないので今の位置でも良いと思いますが、サイズは頻繁に変える必要があるので……。

7.ホームバーをスワイプしてホームに戻ろうとする際に、よく謝ってキャンバスに線が引かれてしまいます。何とかならないものでしょうか……例えば、中央の下からスワイプをする動きの場合は線が引かれないように設定できるようにする、など……ぜひどうにかして貰いたいです！

以上です。
私はイラストを描く目的でProcreatePocketを使用しています。また、iPad版のProcreateも長らく愛用していました。
ひとつひとつは大したことでもないのですが、積み重なると作業の効率が落ちてしまいます。
Procreateは素晴らしいソフトなので、Pocketの方ももっともっとより良く改善されていくことを願っています！

title: GREED HAS COMPLETELY RUINED THIS APP!
body:
lIf I could give this app ZERO stars, I absolutely would.

I’ve been using CapCut since it FIRST came out, and watching this app turn into one giant money grab has been absolutely disgusting. What used to be an amazing, accessible editing app has become a subscription trap where practically everything worth using is locked behind a paywall.

Today is my daughter’s six-month birthday. She was born prematurely, spent 57 days fighting in the NICU, and I wanted to make a beautiful video celebrating how far she’s come. I spent my time choosing pictures, putting together her memories, and making something incredibly meaningful to me.

Only to find out I CAN’T EVEN SAVE THE DAMN VIDEO TO MY CAMERA ROLL WITHOUT PAYING.

Are you kidding me?!

You let people choose templates, upload their personal photos, spend their time creating something, and THEN demand money when they’re ready to save it? That is an absolutely infuriating way to treat your users.

And don’t even get me started on the free templates. The decent ones are increasingly locked behind subscriptions, while the free options are nowhere near the same quality.

I’ve supported this app for YEARS, and this is how longtime users are rewarded? By having basic functionality held hostage behind yet another subscription?

Not everything needs to be monetized. Not every decent feature needs a monthly fee. And people shouldn’t have to pay just to save a sentimental video they’ve already spent time creating.

CapCut, you have completely lost sight of what made people love your app in the first place. Your greed is driving away the very users who helped make your platform popular.

STOP TURNING EVERY SINGLE FEATURE INTO A CASH GRAB.

You took something that used to be genuinely enjoyable and made it frustrating, disappointing, and frankly not worth recommending anymore.

Absolutely pathetic.

title: Extremely poor travel service
body:
I travel internationally often, and my experience with Capital One Travel has been consistently disappointing.
Twice in the past I bought travel protection through Capital One Travel. Both times, when I needed to use it, my claim was turned down over terms buried in the fine print, and I never received a refund.
Most recently, I booked a trip to Paris. Because of the ongoing unrest there, I don't feel safe traveling right now, especially as a person of color. Delta understood the situation and gave me a travel credit for the Seattle–Paris leg. I asked Capital One Travel for the same consideration, a travel credit for the one-way return from Paris to Seattle, and I'm still waiting for a fair resolution.
I'm asking Capital One to review this request and match what Delta has already done. If my experience doesn't change, I plan to use up my remaining points and close the card. I would rather pay a higher annual fee to American Express or Delta for service I can count on.
So far, Capital One's card and travel services haven't lived up to what this card promises.

Grok routinely gave better results with summaries of meeting minutes, specifics on how to perform tasks with automation, and hallucinated less.
I was so frustrated after spending roughly 9 hours this month trying to convince it that the guardrails it was imposing are not applicable, I requested a refund for 1 month of ChatGPT. Their bot was what convinced me to make the request. They denied the request, even with follow-up from their own system telling them that the refund should be granted. title: New update issues
body:
Longtime user here. I use this app exclusively for drawing. This update has some QOL issues, some minor and some so egregious you’d think there was no beta testing period. 

Many things take longer to do, like one extra tap or swipe. The smooth feeling of switching layers, colors, etc is gone. That’s my minor complaint. 

The major stuff:
Why does the color wheel get way brighter around the area you press on it??? You’re selecting colors! You need to see which color you are selecting! 

How come whenever I do literally anything, a notification pops up at the top of the screen that PREVENTS me from accessing any of the tools it covers? I can’t pick a new color until it goes away. 

Why am I fighting the colordrop tool to use it? It takes like a full second of movement to get the little circle to move to where it’s usable. 

Also the new liquid glass sliders are honestly just ugly/distracting and have no practical benefit. They also feel way smaller for some reason. 

I’m hoping that most of these are bugs that will be fixed, or at least customizable.

UPDATE: 
If I could give this zero stars I would because the new colordrop is actually hellish to use. Half the time it decides to fill itself in on a random spot, and it took me like 5 drops to change the threshold from 50 to 0.

title: Monopoly “Scan Your Code” is Broken
body:
Hey @McDonalds @McDonaldsCorp — please escalate this iOS blocker bug to your mobile engineering team while Monopoly is still running!

Environment:
• Device: iPhone 17 Pro Max (MFXM4LL/A)
• OS: iOS 27.0.1 (Latest)
• McDonald's App: v26.72.5 (Latest)

The Monopoly "Scan Your Code" UI requires holding the phone 3–4 inches from the game piece to fit the white scan brackets, but the app locks the camera to the raw 1x lens (which physically cannot focus closer than ~8 inches on Pro iPhones) and disables tap-to-focus.

Side-by-side at the exact same distance:
• iOS Camera App: Auto-switches to Macro Mode (yellow flower icon) + tap-to-focus works. Razor sharp.
• McDonald's App v26.72.5: Locked to 1x lens, tap-to-focus dead, 100% blurry. I've had to manually type every single code.

Switching the scanner's AVCaptureDevice to .builtInTripleCamera (or defaulting the scanner preview to 2x zoom) fixes this immediately!
